requirementForm.title: Booth criteria

requirementForm.moreNote: Design dimensions are filtered by an exact match of length, width and height together. Length runs left to right; width runs front to back. Enter the venue height limit separately; the design height does not automatically fill this field. The product system is a strict filter; style, industry, functional zones and material budget are used for ranking. The material budget excludes installation, transport and other costs and is not an actual quotation.
